note_on_0_9: Draft 0.9 is on public main since cdae5cf. It specifies Appendix F; the reference checker implements part of it and refuses the rest by version (F.12). Theorems T42 to T56 are stated and unproved. The interactive notebook on this site (spec-src/rce/spec.json) still shows the draft 0.7 document, generated from commit 49fa9af, and is not yet regenerated from draft 0.9.
lean_audit_definition: The audit (scripts/lean-audit.sh, audit/Audit.lean) counts every theorem constant in the kernel environment, including constants the elaborator generates, so it is larger than the number of theorem and lemma declarations written in source. The paper's 2,192 was the audit count at engine commit 1eb5f02 over 31 modules.
